```python
script = '''
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io
import os

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"

# 1. Extract text from the entire PDF using PyMuPDF
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
print(f"PDF has {len(doc)} page(s)\\n")

print("=" * 60)
print("TEXT EXTRACTION (all pages)")
print("=" * 60)
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    print(f"\\n--- Page {i+1} ---")
    print(text if text.strip() else "(no extractable text)")

# 2. OCR on the first page image
print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("OCR ON FIRST PAGE IMAGE")
print("=" * 60)

first_page = doc[0]
# Render at 300 DPI for good OCR quality
mat = fitz.Matrix(300/72, 300/72)
pix = first_page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
img_data = pix.tobytes("png")
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_data))
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
print(ocr_text)

doc.close()
'''
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py")
print(result)
```
